public_key is the base64 of an Ed25519 SPKI DER public key. It is NOT a
secret: the matching private key is generated on the node and never leaves
it. Get a node's value from, on that node:
The receiver re-reads this file on every request, so adding, disabling or
re-keying a node needs no restart. An entry that is malformed, disabled, or
carries an unusable key simply does not register — the receiver fails closed
and its beats are refused with 401.
Adding a second node here is all that a second node requires. There is
deliberately no scheduler, no routing and no fleet control: registration
makes a node VISIBLE, nothing more.
